title: [Shopify] Fix GraphQL rate limiter under-waiting after elapsed time
summary: The Shopify connector's GraphQL rate limiter was waiting incorrectly when time had elapsed between requests, causing it to re-issue requests too early into the throttle window. The fix anchors the wake time to the current moment plus remaining wait time instead of incorrectly subtracting the elapsed gap twice.
key_points: Rate limiter under-waited after elapsed time between Shopify responses and next request, producing avoidable GraphQL throttling on high-volume shops
Bug was double-subtracting elapsed time when calculating the next request's allowed time
Fix anchors wake time at CurrentDateTime plus remaining wait instead of anchoring at LastRequestedOn
Eliminates redundant assignment that subtracted elapsed gap a second time
Added test case that verifies correct wait time remains when elapsed time has passed since last request
